speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: What does this sign mean?

options_en.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead makes a sharp turn at an extreme angle.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: You should yield to a pedestrian:

options_en.text: Only if they are in a crosswalk.
At all times, even if they are not obeying traffic laws.
Only if the traffic light favors the pedestrian.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: On a slippery road, you should keep a following distance that is:

options_en.text: The same as normal.
Longer than normal.
Shorter than normal.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: Any amount of alcohol may affect a driver's:

options_en.text: Right-of-way privileges.
Judgment and physical coordination.
Knowledge.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: Which of the following commonly causes traffic crashes?

options_en.text: Speeding or driving too fast for conditions.
Getting enough rest and staying alert.
Watching the road and focusing on driving.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: Using a cell phone while driving is distracting because:

options_en.text: It makes you worried about the call cost.
It takes your hands, eyes, and attention away from driving.
It gets the attention of other drivers.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: When stopped by police for a violation or equipment check, you must show:

options_en.text: Only your insurance and registration.
Only your license.
Your license, insurance, and registration.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: Night driving is harder because:

options_en.text: The speed limit is higher at night.
There are fewer cars on the road at night.
It is hard to judge distance and speed in the dark.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: If you have a tire blowout, you should:

options_en.text: Tap or pump the brakes.
Slow down gradually and use light braking.
Apply the brakes hard and fast.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: What does this sign mean?

options_en.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.
Stop only if needed.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: Crashes are more likely when:

options_en.text: All vehicles travel at about the same speed.
One lane travels faster than other lanes.
One vehicle travels faster or slower than other traffic.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: Motorcycles are entitled to:

options_en.text: The same full lane width as other vehicles.
The width of the sidewalk.
Half the width of a lane.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: On a wet or icy road, you should:

options_en.text: Reduce your speed.
Drive at the posted speed.
Speed up.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: If there is no crosswalk and a pedestrian is crossing your lane, you should:

options_en.text: Make sure the pedestrian sees you before driving.
Drive carefully around the pedestrian.
Stop and let the pedestrian finish crossing.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: Distracted driving is:

options_en.text: Anything that causes you to steer suddenly while driving.
Anything that takes your attention away from driving.
Anything that makes you focus more on driving.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: Tailgating (driving too close to another car's bumper):

options_en.text: Can make other drivers angry and frustrated.
Cannot result in a traffic ticket.
Prevents other cars from cutting in front of you.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: Which driving skills are affected by alcohol and/or drugs?

options_en.text: Alertness.
Coordination.
Both of the above.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: At a crosswalk:

options_en.text: You must let pedestrians cross first.
Pedestrians must let you go first.
Construction workers have the right of way.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: What does this sign mean?

options_en.text: Stop.
Merge.
The road will turn ahead.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: Blind spots are:

options_en.text: Areas where your vision blurs when you are tired.
Parts of the road you cannot see in your mirrors.
Road signs and signals.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: When passing another vehicle:

options_en.text: Pass it as slowly as possible.
Drive at the same speed as the car you are passing.
Pass it as safely and quickly as possible.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: A green traffic light means you should:

options_en.text: Stop completely.
Speed up to quickly cross the intersection.
Go straight, turn left, or turn right as allowed.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: You are driving behind a large truck on the freeway. You should drive:

options_en.text: Closer behind it than you would a regular car.
Farther behind it than you would a regular car.
To the right side of the truck and wait to pass.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: When you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection, you must:

options_en.text: Come to a complete stop.
Keep driving at your normal speed.
Slow down and drive carefully.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: When turning left at an intersection:

options_en.text: You must yield to oncoming cars and pedestrians.
Oncoming cars and pedestrians must yield to you.
You never need to yield to oncoming cars or pedestrians.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: What does this sign mean?

options_en.text: The road ends ahead.
The road splits and you must go either right or left.
A four-way intersection is ahead.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: There is no crosswalk and you see a pedestrian crossing in front of you. You should:

options_en.text: Make eye contact and then pass the pedestrian.
Slow down while passing the pedestrian.
Stop and let the pedestrian finish crossing.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: To keep your tires from losing grip on wet roads, you should:

options_en.text: Make sharp turns.
Press hard on the brakes.
Slow down.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: Backing up your vehicle is:

options_en.text: Always dangerous.
Dangerous only if you have a helper.
Only dangerous in large trucks.

speed-and-distance-quiz.question_en: At a railroad crossing, you must:

options_en.text: Watch for vehicles that must always stop (school buses, trucks with hazardous materials, etc.).
Watch for trains coming from either direction.
Both of the above.
